on 6 April, 2026
145

Tapas 
 Crr 88 of 2026
 Ia No. Cran/1/2026
 Sukhdeo Mahato And Anr.
 Vs
 The State Of West Bengal And Anr.

Mr. Mayank Roy
 ... for the petitioner
 Mr. Abhishek Singh
 ... for the de facto complainant
 Mr. Nilay Chakraborty
 Mr. Sagnik Sankar Sikdar
 ... for the State

1. 
This is an application praying for quashing of criminal proceedings being Siliguri Police Station Case No. 42 of 2018 dated 22.01.2018 under Sections 420/506 read with Section 34 of the Indian Penal Code, 186.

Charge Sheet has been submitted being Charge Sheet No. 827 of 2018 dated 27.12.2018,
corresponding to G.R. No. 190 of 2018 pending before the learned Additional Chief Judicial Magistrate at Siliguri, District- Darjeeling.

entities.text: Additional Chief Judicial Magistrate at Siliguri, District- Darjeeling
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: The Learned Counsel for the de facto complainant is present today.
2. It is submitted that both the parties settled the matter amicable.
3. Mr. Chakraborty, Learned Counsel for the State submitted that he has nothing to oppose in this application.
Accordingly, the aforesaid prosecution is hereby quashed.
4. The petitioner is released from bail bond.
